about: Response-time budgets for the running app, checked by perf_check.py. 'total' is the whole request as the caller sees it; every other key is a part the app reports in the response's timings_ms. Budgets are about double what was measured, so ordinary variation does not trip them. When a part gets faster for good, lower its budget.

checks.name: Routines listing, warm
checks.why: Every open of the chat panel requests this. Measured 2026-11-10 on the author's workspace after the routine-check and parse caches: total about 300 to 400 ms (it was about 1,000 ms), list_routines 175 to 230, check_routines about 1, diffs 50 to 140, contexts 50 to 90, prompts about 20.
